transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I hope I'm explaining this right. I'm here because... well, for months now, I’ve been noticing this pattern, and I really don't want to sound difficult or, you know, unreasonable. But... my sister’s appointments keep getting moved around, her bills show up with all these errors, and people just constantly 'forget' to call me back. 

Everyone keeps telling me it’s just innocent mistakes. And, you know, I supervise an administrative office, so I always try to be understanding about paperwork errors. Does that make sense? But... it’s just happening too often now. Even though they say it's just mistakes, I... I know they’re deliberately keeping information from me. It really feels like they're trying to push me out of making decisions for her. I hope that doesn't sound too strange to say?
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people couldn't see or hear?

Oh, goodness, no. Um... no, nothing like that at all. 

I know I might sound a little... intense, maybe, when I talk about the appointments and the staff, but I promise my mind is perfectly sound. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I'm really just noticing real things, like emails and schedules, mostly because of my background in administration. 

I hope you don't think I'm... you know, losing touch with reality or anything? I'm just trying to be as accurate as possible for you. Is that... is that the kind of answer you needed?
Aside from your sister's care, have you often felt throughout your life that friends, colleagues, or others had hidden motives or couldn't be trusted?

Oh, no, no. Not at all. I mean... I've always had wonderful relationships with my colleagues and friends. I really pride myself on being a good team player, you know? In my line of work, you have to build trust, and I've always felt very supported by the people around me. 

This situation with my sister's care team is... well, it's very specific to them. It's not a general feeling I have about people. I try to see the best in everyone, I really do. I hope I'm not coming across as someone who is naturally suspicious or difficult to work with? Because that's not me at all. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how things are. Does that help clarify things?
Have you ever felt that an outside force or person was controlling your thoughts or actions?

Oh, my, no. No, definitely not. Um... I'm always very much in control of my own mind and my own choices. 

I know sometimes when people get stressed, they might feel overwhelmed, but I've never felt like anyone else was... pulling the strings, so to speak. I just go to work, do my best to manage the office, and try to advocate for my sister. That's really all it is. I hope that makes sense? I just want to reassure you that I'm completely myself, just... just a very concerned sister trying to navigate a tricky situation. Is that the kind of information you're looking for?
